title: Old-time drummers Son Fewclothes and Son White; bands that kept the regular beat
summary: Robertson names old-time drummers like Son Fewclothes and Son White, mentions George Williams as a newer drummer, and says three old bands carried the regular beat.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Oh yeah, sure, the bass drummer...
Yeah, they take old son, few clothes, and you got this boy here...oh, what's this boy's name right now? I know him good, uptown there, son White. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Son White, he's an old timer.

Son, few clothes, son White, old time drummers. He's been out. He was on back there. Old, old time drummers. Good drummers too. Now we got one now, now...I can't think of him, but he wasn't about no old time, but he got George Williams, well he's not no old time. George Williams started playing music a few years ago. He was young, right? Yeah.
He got a band, George Williams Band, but he's not back in that, not back in that bracket.
Well, would you say that you're more or less beating the same now as you, as the old drummers did the same when you were a boy? That's right.
You take a, I'll tell you what band carried it, regular beat, the old timers, the Erika, Sean Casner, and myself. Now those three bands carried it at the same time, tight down, old timers.
